body:
Players can connect a companion from their current Voyage, use distinct Journal, Lens and Charts workspaces, and return to the same Chronicle without losing continuity. The bounded repairs keep the phone passage readable and desktop handoff status visible beside an open Charts drawer.

The product, contracts, media, E2E and original evidence publication remain unchanged from frozen evidence head `80e350d8c59f6b132b573cc2b8158c5f7ae11a82`. Accepted maintenance [#784](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/pull/784) and finite successor [#785](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/pull/785) are adopted through normal history at candidate `6168c3668cfd2c590ea89bb2e5c01813835e56d8`, accepted base `597c22c20a9b5e725baf06565746df2562cdf98e`, tree `6a8b3d8a2a2a24dd9a964e255b2c3034f450e0a7`. The 18 maintenance/admission paths comprise the 17 authorized overlay paths and the separately validated registry. The existing 90-minute final-check ceiling for #721 and 45-minute ceiling for other PRs remain unchanged.

Validation and provenance:

- Original R23 [capture 39520615298/1](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/actions/runs/39520615298) and [authenticated review12 39551039268/1](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/actions/runs/39551039268) succeeded for seven contracts and 32 generic plus six paired contexts. Original source/base/archive/report identities and custody seals are retained. Installed R26 validates their adoption; capture and review allowances are zero.
- Current non-consuming checks passed: complete committed-Git human evidence validation with `automatedOnly:false`, live original-manifest/provider/custody attestation, and 30 historical runs across 439 fresh authenticated GETs. This attestation check does not claim a fresh full capture-ZIP download; the protected provider must still perform its unchanged full-archive evidence-required admission. The published default plan must match the frozen plan: 291 unit files, eight technical browser suites, eight obligation groups and 13 commands.
- The three original B1 functional instances are resolved with only approved editorial work deferred to Refit (`HP-NC-CD-B1-01/02/03`); original severity is retained. Both B2 instances are resolved. Functional readability, accessibility, privacy, security and continuity remain mandatory.
- Failed [R25 ordinary 39622005087/1](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/actions/runs/39622005087) remains spent. Its eight completed whole obligations and 50 browser passes are historical checkpoints, not whole acceptance; any reuse requires complete fingerprints and authenticated producer checks. Accepted #784 corrects the automated replay artifact-root boundary while preserving canonical publication validation. R23/R24 failures, old records, counters, original bytes and campaign epoch remain intact.

The single `ready_for_review` transition is the sole R26 qualification trigger after exact remote-head/base, skipped draft synchronization, published-plan and empty-namespace checks. No manual draft dispatch is used. R26 permits one ordinary/technical/replay sequence, with no retry, reset, refund, capture or review. Its today-only deadline is October 21, 23:59:59 America/New_York (`2026-10-22T03:59:59Z`). Protected R26 run 39656414105/1 and required Mainline Decision passed. PR #721 merged normally at 2026-10-21T22:23:22Z as aaff919428ef9ab421579415ce3409949724760d; its landed tree matches the qualified head. Independent landed documentation, Feature Catalog and evidence validation passed.

Owner, physical/device, Refit-owner and Parallax acceptance remain separate and unclaimed.

## Documentation checklist

- [ ] User-visible feature documentation, current status, and feature status were reviewed.
- [ ] Changelog was updated when relevant.
- [x] No automation instructions were added to human-facing documentation by evidence publication.
- [ ] Engineering records are indexed and current links are valid.
- [x] `npm run docs:validate` passed for the final landed tree.
